gaps.sentence: Payments must be made ___ advance; invoices cannot be accepted.
gaps.explanation: 'In advance' = before the event or deadline.

gaps.sentence: He did it ___ purpose, not by accident.
___ any rate, we still have enough time.
gaps.explanation: 'At any rate' = whatever else is true.

gaps.sentence: The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The play closed after three nights ___ account of poor ticket sales.
gaps.explanation: 'On account of' = because of, in a formal register.

gaps.sentence: She succeeded in ___ of repeated setbacks.
Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'in the care of' = looked after by.
